label: Allied Telesis AT-x530-28GTXm
description: Allied Telesis AT-x530-28GTXm stackable L3 access switch: 20x 10/100/1000T RJ-45, 4x 100M/1G/2.5G/5G RJ-45, 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, no PoE, 160 Gbps switching fabric, 119 Mpps.

fabric.note: Vendor switching-fabric figure (forwarding rate 119 Mpps), the full-duplex aggregate of the port rates: 2 x (80000 Mbit/s of line rate).

notes: No PoE anywhere on the box - the GT is the unpowered twin of the 28GPXm, on the same 160 Gbps fabric. Port numbering from the front-panel figures: copper 1-20, multi-gigabit 21-24, SFP+ 25-28, with 27/S1 and 28/S2 the default VCStack stacking ports (modelled as Ethernet, because disabling VCStack turns them into ordinary SFP+ ports). 441 x 323 x 44 mm, 4.8 kg, 55 W, 42 dBA. The half-depth chassis is why this model takes the AT-BRKT-J22 wall-mount kit. Console is the front-panel RJ-45 RS-232 port (AlliedWare Plus default 9600 8-N-1, no flow control; the switch ships with the manager/friend logins), reached with the RJ-45-to-DB-9 cable in the box or an AT-VT-Kit3 USB-to-serial cable. The management panel also carries a USB port and the eco-friendly button; neither is a network interface, so neither is modelled. Numbers: the x530 Series datasheet SPECIFICATIONS and Power and Noise tables and the model page at https://www.alliedtelesis.com/us/en/products/switches/x530-series; port numbering from the x530 Quick Installation Guide (https://www.alliedtelesis.com/sites/default/files/file/2022-03/ati-x530-english-qig.pdf) and, for the 10/18/28GSX/DP port fronts, the VCStack installation guide (https://www.alliedtelesis.com/sites/default/files/documents/installation-guides/ati_x530_vc_stacking_ig.pdf).
